source_documents.title: Multifunctional Supramolecular Assemblies with Aggregation-Induced Emission (AIE) for Cell Line Identification, Cell Contamination Evaluation and Cancer Cell Discrimination

reference_evidence_units.quote: not all the three pyridinium groups of one TPE-3EP molecule could be captured by CB[8]
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-3EP with CB[8]
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 1H NMR titration in D2O, guest 0.2 mM; Fig. 1 p.7.
reference_evidence_units.statement: New downfield-shifted peaks coexist with weakened original pyridinium peaks above one equivalent host; authors infer incomplete arm inclusion from steric hindrance and a hyperbranched assembly.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not transfer the near-complete TPE-2EP inclusion claim to this three-arm guest; hyperbranching is proposed, not crystallographically resolved.

reference_evidence_units.quote: their largest absorbance peaks had different degrees of red-shift.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-3EP with CB[8]
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Ultrapure water, guest 30 micromolar, guest:CB[8] 1:1.5; Fig. 2A p.9.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Target absorption maximum shifts from 375 to 390 nm after CB[8] assembly.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Absorption shifts are target-specific; electrostatic perturbation does not alone establish ICT, an exciton or an excimer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The UV/Vis absorption spectra (A) and fluorescence spectra (B)
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-3EP with and without CB[8]
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 2B-C visually inspected; ultrapure water, guest 30 micromolar; ratio 1:1.5. Absolute PL yield method on pp.18-19.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The target's PL intensity increases and blue-shifts on complexation; Fig. 2C gives quantum yield 1.0% to 3.7%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Values are read from the displayed target-specific table, not inferred from intensity scaling. No emission lifetime or separated rate constants are supplied.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the intramolecular motion in the bulk assembly could be further restricted.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-2EP, TPE-3EP and TPE-4EP CB[8] assemblies
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Aqueous host-induced assembly; p.8 photophysical discussion.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose that shared CB[8] cavities, bulky host and linked neighboring molecules restrict intramolecular motions, explaining fluorescence enhancement.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: An explicit series interpretation including the target, not independently measured molecular motion. It does not imply equal occupancy or enhancement across the series.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the hydrophobic cavity of CB[8] had a low-polarity microenvironment
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-EP series including TPE-3EP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Blue shifts of the host-bound aqueous assemblies, Fig. 2B.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors attribute blue-shifted emission to a lower-polarity cavity environment.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Retain this polarity interpretation without upgrading it to experimentally established ICT/TICT; the paper does not explicitly resolve a CT excited state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: By calculating the quantitative data, the Ka between three kinds of AIE molecules and CB[8]
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-3EP with CB[8]
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fluorescence titrations reported from SI S2; methods p.19 use 25 micromolar guest; excitation 375 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The target's reported association constant is 5.69e7, assigned in the stated 2EP/3EP/4EP sequence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI fit equations/uncertainties and the dimensional convention were not inspected; do not overinterpret a simple binding constant for a multivalent assembly.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the larger TPE-3EP@CB[8] and TPE-4EP@CB[8] were both about 400-500 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-3EP@CB[8]
reference_evidence_units.conditions: SEM and cryo-TEM discussion, Fig. 3; 30 micromolar samples.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports target assemblies as roughly spherical, about 400-500 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Morphology is reported from the main text; it is not molecular-resolution packing or proof of identical aggregation in cells.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the enhancement of fluorescence intensity was the effect of the accumulation of assemblies.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-3EP@CB[8] in cells
reference_evidence_units.conditions: SV-HUC-1 and T24 cells, 30 micromolar assembly; time-dependent flow cytometry, Fig. 5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors attribute increasing cell fluorescence to uptake/accumulation. TPE-3EP assemblies stain primarily inside cells and give less fluorescence increase than TPE-2EP but more than TPE-4EP.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not assign all cellular signal increase to per-molecule photophysical turn-on; size/shape-driven uptake is an author interpretation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: it was hardly observed the fluorescence signals of AIE supramolecular assemblies in cells
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPE-EP series including TPE-3EP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Low-temperature co-staining control at 4 C versus 37 C; 20 min; Fig. 4 and SI S6-S7 discussed.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Assembly fluorescence in cells is strongly reduced at 4 C while tracker signal remains; authors use this to support active uptake.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Temperature inhibition is not a unique proof of a particular endocytosis pathway; SI controls not inspected.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Authors explicitly propose CB[8]- and assembly-imposed RIM, supported indirectly by optical enhancement rather than direct torsional measurements.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Cavity confinement and linked supramolecular assemblies are the enabling environment for RIM; overlapping mechanisms, not independent proof.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: NMR and optical titrations support target-specific CB[8] association and changed emission; occupancy limitations are retained.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Authors explicitly propose CB[8]- and assembly-imposed RIM, supported indirectly by optical enhancement rather than direct torsional measurements.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Cavity confinement and linked supramolecular assemblies are the enabling environment for RIM; overlapping mechanisms, not independent proof.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: NMR and optical titrations support target-specific CB[8] association and changed emission; occupancy limitations are retained.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The paper proposes electrostatic/polarity effects but does not establish target CT/TICT; do not infer it from pyridinium chemistry or a blue shift.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established here; ground-state protonation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific exciton, excimer or new intermolecular emissive state is established; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Quantum yield increases and cell accumulation are documented, but no distinct radiative-rate/state-balance mechanism is isolated.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet or metal/energy-transfer photophysics is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established in this extraction.
